description: Expected outcome of every T0 test on the current release branch. It differs from the previous release only where a release declares a progression test: v0.0.1 flipped T0.12 (README truth); v0.0.2 flipped T0.6 (dual Kafka listener, P-1) and added T-REPRO (every pulled image pinned to version+digest, P-3/P-4) as a new, already-passing gate; v0.0.3 flipped T0.7 (Trino queries the operational Postgres, P-2), measured on ENV-W and falsified in three cases before being believed. v0.0.4 adds T0.13 (every memory ceiling cites its measurement) as a declared XFAIL: fifteen of the seventeen ceilings were reasoned about rather than measured, and two of those were wrong. It flips when #23 measures the tiers.
